title: Spectrum-Adaptive Generalization Bounds for Trained Deep Transformers
abstract: arXiv:2605.07297v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Understanding why trained Transformers generalize well is a fundamental problem in modern machine learning theory, and complexity-based generalization bounds provide a principled way to study this question. While existing norm-based bounds for Transformers remove the explicit polynomial dependence on the hidden dimension, they typically impose fixed norm constraints specified a priori and can exhibit unfavorable exponential dependence on depth. In this paper, we derive spectrum-adaptive post hoc generalization bounds for multi-layer Transformers. Under layerwise spectral norm control, the bounds are expressed in terms of layerwise Schatten quantities of the query-key, value, and feedforward weight matrices. Since the Schatten indices need not be fixed a priori and can instead be selected after training, separately for each matrix type and layer, the bounds adaptively trade off spectral complexity against the dimension- and depth-depe

translated_title: 训练后深度Transformer的谱自适应泛化界
translated_abstract: 理解训练后的Transformer为何具有良好的泛化能力是现代机器学习理论中的一个基本问题，而基于复杂度的泛化界为研究这一问题提供了一种有原则的方法。尽管现有的基于范数的Transformer泛化界消除了对隐藏维度的显式多项式依赖，但它们通常强加事先指定的固定范数约束，并且可能对深度表现出不利的指数依赖。在本文中，我们为多层Transformer推导了谱自适应的事后泛化界。在逐层谱范数控制下，这些界以查询-键矩阵、值矩阵和前馈权重矩阵的逐层Schatten量来表示。由于Schatten指数无需事先固定，而是可以在训练后针对每种矩阵类型和每一层分别选择，因此这些界能够在谱复杂性与维度和深度依赖之间进行自适应权衡。
tldr: 该论文提出了针对训练后多层Transformer的谱自适应事后泛化界，通过在训练后逐层、逐矩阵类型灵活选择Schatten指数，在谱复杂性与维度、深度依赖之间实现自适应权衡，克服了现有方法需事先固定范数约束且对深度呈指数依赖的缺陷。
en_tdlr: This paper derives spectrum-adaptive post hoc generalization bounds for trained multi-layer Transformers, where the Schatten indices of query-key, value, and feedforward weight matrices can be selected after training for each layer and matrix type, adaptively trading off spectral complexity against dimension- and depth-dependence.
